Another study9 found that increasing dietary fat consumption and eliminating helminthic infection further in- creased serum retinol concentrations in children given food high in betacarotene. For a trial reporting improved vitamin A status with betacarotene plus zinc compared with betacarotene or zinc alone, and the sug- gestion that zinc may have a role in the conversion of betacaro- tene to retinol, see Vitamin A Deficiency, under Zinc, p.2001.
